# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    return -float(node.id)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 2:
                total += node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    return -total

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out

# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    weighted_latency = 0.0
    total_rate = 0.0
    worst_latency = 0.0
    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        elif destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and ctx.graph.rate[edge] > 0.0:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[edge]
                weighted_latency += rate * latency
                total_rate += rate
                worst_latency = max(worst_latency, latency)

    dependency_cost = 0.0
    if total_rate > 0.0:
        dependency_cost = weighted_latency / total_rate

    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    headroom_cost = 0.0
    if cpu_after + pod.cpu_request > node.cpu_capacity:
        headroom_cost += 0.5
    if mem_after + pod.mem_request > node.mem_capacity:
        headroom_cost += 0.25

    activation_cost = 0.0
    empty_cpu = node.cpu_allocated == node.cpu_capacity - node.cpu_capacity
    empty_mem = node.mem_allocated == node.mem_capacity - node.mem_capacity
    if node.suspended or (empty_cpu and empty_mem):
        activation_cost = 0.002 * node.power_idle_w

    dynamic_cost = 0.0005 * max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    placement_cost = float(node.id) + 0.08 * dependency_cost
    placement_cost += 0.02 * worst_latency
    placement_cost += headroom_cost + activation_cost + dynamic_cost
    return -placement_cost

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    weighted_latency = 0.0
    total_rate = 0.0
    worst_latency = 0.0
    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        incoming = False
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        elif destination == pod.id:
            other = source
            incoming = True
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and ctx.graph.rate[edge] > 0.0:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                if incoming:
                    latency = ctx.nodes[neighbor.current_node].latency_to_ms[node.id]
                if neighbor.current_node == node.id:
                    latency = 0.0
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[edge]
                weighted_latency += rate * latency
                total_rate += rate
                worst_latency = max(worst_latency, latency)

    dependency_cost = 0.0
    if total_rate > 0.0:
        dependency_cost = weighted_latency / total_rate

    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    headroom_cost = 0.0
    if cpu_after + pod.cpu_request > node.cpu_capacity:
        headroom_cost += 0.5
    if cpu_after >= node.cpu_capacity:
        headroom_cost += 1.0
    if mem_after + pod.mem_request > node.mem_capacity:
        headroom_cost += 0.25
    if mem_after >= node.mem_capacity:
        headroom_cost += 0.5

    empty_cpu = node.cpu_allocated == node.cpu_capacity - node.cpu_capacity
    empty_mem = node.mem_allocated == node.mem_capacity - node.mem_capacity
    activation_cost = 0.0
    if node.suspended or (empty_cpu and empty_mem):
        activation_cost = 0.004 * max(node.power_idle_w, 0.0)

    dynamic_cost = 0.00075 * max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    placement_cost = float(node.id) + 0.08 * dependency_cost
    placement_cost += 0.02 * worst_latency
    placement_cost += headroom_cost + activation_cost + dynamic_cost
    return -placement_cost

    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
